```{r}

library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("adult_2022.csv")
```

Beta 1 = age, Beta 2 = gender, Beta 3 = Urban, Beta 4 = Edu

```{r}
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
data <- na.omit(data)
data$prov_id <- as.integer(as.factor(data$province))
X_matrix <- model.matrix(~ age + male + urban + edu, data = data)
X_matrix <- X_matrix[, -1]

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(data),
  J = length(unique(data$prov_id)),
  K = ncol(X_matrix),
  X = X_matrix,
  prov = data$prov_id,
  y = as.integer(data$married)
)

stan_code <- "
data {
  int<lower=0> N;               
  int<lower=1> J;              
  int<lower=1> K;              
  
  matrix[N, K] X;              
  int<lower=1, upper=J> prov[N];
  int<lower=0, upper=1> y[N];  
}

parameters {
  vector[K] beta;              
  real alpha0;                 
  real<lower=0> sigma_prov;    
  vector[J] alpha_prov_raw;   
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[J] alpha_prov;
  alpha_prov = alpha0 + sigma_prov * alpha_prov_raw;
}

model {
  beta ~ normal(0, 5);
  alpha0 ~ normal(0, 5);
  sigma_prov ~ student_t(3, 0, 2.5); 
  alpha_prov_raw ~ std_normal();    
  y ~ bernoulli_logit(alpha_prov[prov] + X * beta);
}
"
```

```{r}
fit <- stan(
  model_code = stan_code,  
  data = stan_data,
  iter = 2000,            
  warmup = 1000,        
  chains = 4,            
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95) 
)
```

```{r}
print(fit, pars = c("alpha0", "beta", "sigma_prov"))

traceplot(fit, pars = c("alpha0", "beta", "sigma_prov"), inc_warmup = FALSE)

plot(fit, pars = c("beta", "sigma_prov")) + 
  ggtitle("Posterior Distributions of Fixed Effects and Regional Variance")
```
